'''Buel Dowtry''' is the fletcher in [[Emond's Field]].

== Appearance ==
He is white haired with a sharp nose.

== Activities ==
He helps defend Emond's Field against the invading [[Trollocs]] as an archer.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He relocates to the [[Black Tower]] when his grandson, [[Jonneth Dowtry]], joins the [[Asha'man]].
